raw_response:
I have 9 mu of land. Seven mu I plant wheat in autumn and then maize in summer. Two mu I keep for cotton. I have seven mouths to feed, so every mu must produce. I only went to primary school, but I have farmed for 30 years since I was 15. My father taught me, and I watch what my neighbors do. That is how I decide.

For wheat on 7 mu: I buy improved seed from the dealer in town, 13 kg per mu. Before planting I spread one 50 kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu and run the rotary tiller. At jointing time I topdress with 15 kg urea per mu. That is about 15 kg nitrogen, 8 kg phosphorus, and 7 kg potassium per mu. I will irrigate three times — after planting if it is dry, at jointing, and at grain filling. I will spray pesticide twice, once for aphids and once for leaf rust. Last year I got 500 kg per mu doing exactly this. I will do the same.

For maize on those same 7 mu: Right after wheat harvest in early June, I plant Zhengdan 958 hybrid seed, 2.5 kg per mu. There is no time to plow — I use the no-tillage seeder. I put 40 kg compound fertilizer per mu at planting, then 18 kg urea when the plants are knee-high. That is 16 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, 5 kg potassium per mu. Three irrigations and two pesticide sprays. If the weather is decent I expect 600 kg per mu.

For cotton on 2 mu: I plough deep in spring because cotton roots need soft soil down deep. I plant improved cotton seed, 1.5 kg per mu. Base fertilizer is one 50 kg bag of compound per mu, and I topdress with 10 kg urea at flowering. That is 14 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, 6 kg potassium per mu. Cotton needs more water and more medicine than grain crops. I irrigate four times and spray pesticide five times for bollworm and mites. I expect 100 kg of ginned cotton per mu.

I know fertilizer prices went up this year, but I will not cut back. I would rather waste some fertilizer than lose yield. A bad harvest is a disaster for my family. Wasting money on extra fertilizer is only a loss of money. I learned that from my father and from watching Old Wang across the road. He changed his wheat fertilizer one year and his yield dropped. I will not make that mistake. I do what worked before.
